text:
maria: Heads-up — CI flakes started spiking in apac-ephemeral pool ~02:20 UTC (lots of preemptions). Anyone else seeing elevated eviction rates?
jon: yup, saw ~18% eviction rate on apac-ephemeral from 02:15–02:30. Jobs restarted automatically but some long tests hit timeout. Logs show PREEMPTED events. :grimacing:
kevin: We're getting maintenance notifications from vendor for that region; they scheduled host reclamations. Not the usual pattern — looks like rolling host reboots.
maria: Any ETA on when the rolling will finish? We're mid-release window.
vendor-status-bot: vendor-apac: rolling-maintenance in progress, estimated completion 2026-03-18T04:30:00Z. Impact: ephemeral (spot) instances may be evicted. See https://status.vendor.example/notice123
anya: We should consider short-term reroute of critical CI to dedicated-gpu-pool or fallback to reserved nodes. Quick command to flip route in infra config:
```
# temp route to reserved pool
infractl routes update --pool ci-critical --target reserved-gpu-pool --priority 1 --ttl 2h
```
kevin: That command works. If we route, we need to be mindful of burst capacity and quota. Current reserved pool has ~12 A100 slots free.
mike: If we need more reserved capacity I can approve a one-time burst commit for +8 A100s for 24h. Cost estimate ~ $3.6k. We should only do this if CI impact is >10% deploy failures.
jom: (typo meant jon) — metrics: failed deploys due to timeouts jumped from 2% -> 9% in last hour. Still below mike's threshold but trending up.
maria: Can we do a partial route? Only route long-running tests (integration/test-long) to reserved and keep short jobs in ephemeral?
anya: Yeah, we can add a matcher:
```
infractl routes update --pool ci-critical --target reserved-gpu-pool --match "job.name =~ /test-long/" --ttl 3h
```
kevin: I'll prepare the route change and dry-run in staging. Also scheduling a short autoscale increase on reserved pool just in case.
maria: Thanks. Mike, please hold on burst approval until we see staging dry-run results. If eviction continues after maintenance ETA we'll flip.
vendor-status-bot: vendor-apac: next maintenance window update at 2026-03-18T03:45:00Z.
mike: ack. ping me once kevin posts dry-run output.
kevin: Dry-run done — no config syntax issues. Staging showed route applied and long tests moved to reserved pool, job start latency +3s but stable.
john: whoops meant jon again — looks good from my side, long tests passed in staging.
maria: OK let's schedule the match route at 03:10 UTC (20 minutes before vendor estimated finish) so we avoid any evicted runs. kevin, can you run at 03:10?
kevin: I can do it at 03:10, will also kick off a smoke check.
maria: Also @procurement — please capture ops cost (rough) — mike estimated $3.6k for full burst; partial routing should be << that but still track.
aya: (typos fixed: anya) — procurement is looped via procurement thread, will update.
mike: Thx. If vendor posts extension we'll consider full burst.
vendor-status-bot: vendor-apac: maintenance extended to 2026-03-18T05:00:00Z due to host health checks. Potential for continued spot evictions.
maria: Ugh. If extension holds, we may need to keep the match route for longer. Kevin, after you apply please set TTL to 6h so we don't have to reapply every hour.
kevin: Will set TTL 6h. Applying at 03:10 UTC.
maria: Post-apply — please paste infractl output here and confirm smoke tests.
kevin: APPLIED at 2026-03-18T03:10:12Z
```
route: ci-critical -> reserved-gpu-pool
match: job.name =~ /test-long/
ttl: 6h
status: active
```
kevin: Smoke tests green. Long tests running on reserved nodes. No immediate failures.
maria: Great. I'll monitor deploy success rate. If failure >5% we re-evaluate. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
mike: Thanks team. Keep cost notes handy.
vendor-status-bot: vendor-apac: final update — maintenance complete 2026-03-18T05:02:00Z, eviction rates back to baseline.
maria: Closing the loop — we'll leave the match route until 09:00 UTC to ensure no residual disruptions, then revert. Will update on any cost impact.
kevin: I'll schedule automatic revert at 09:00 UTC and post confirmation.
maria: Perfect — thread resolved.
